cited.quote: G.O.(Ms).No.349, Industries (MIF.2) Department, dated 14.12.2021.
The relief assistance of Rs.5,000 per salt workers’ family provided during the past four years

rationale: C1 (GO 69 of 30.03.2022) refers to the earlier GO 349 dated 14.12.2021 that sanctioned Rs.5,000 per annum relief for registered salt workers' families, then sanctions funds for 8465 families. C3 reports yearly disbursement of Rs.5,000 per family 2021-22 to 2024-25. Scope, amount and beneficiaries match; earliest GO is dated 14.12.2021.

cited.quote: Four Junction Point in Pattukottai 234.77.00 234.77.00 0.00.00 100

rationale: Extracts C2-C4 cover railway land acquisition for other lines (Tindivanam-Nagari, Villupuram-Dindigul, etc.). Only C2 mentions Pattukottai, as a junction point land item, not a Thanjavur-Orathanadu-Pattukottai new line. C1 and C5 are road/village lists. No official step for this line is shown.

cited.quote: Under this scheme, financial assistance of Rs.25,000 for non-graduates and Rs.50,000 for degree / diploma holders is given
Scheme will continue to be implemented without any change

rationale: C1 (2025) still shows Rs.25,000 for non-graduates under the orphan girls scheme, with the 8 gram gold coin already given. C4 (GO 46, 2022) says the Annai Teresa scheme continues without any change. No order raising the amount to Rs.30,000 appears.

cited.quote: decided to constitute a Technical Committee with the members as mentioned in para 4 above
11,907 new buses sanctioned up to FY 2025-26. This includes 9,436 diesel buses, 746 CNG

rationale: C5 (GO 92, 2024-08-14) constitutes a technical committee for CNG conversion of diesel buses in all eight STUs, a preparatory step. C2 shows only 746 CNG buses sanctioned among 11,907. No extract shows CNG buses operating in all towns and corporation areas.

cited.quote: pursuant to G.O. (Ms) No.13, Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department, dated 07.06.2022.
four percent of jobs in Government and Private sectors was 53 reserved for the Differently abled persons

rationale: C1 reports four percent employment reservation being implemented, with a High-Level Committee monitoring it under GO 13 dated 07.06.2022. C3 states four percent of government jobs are reserved. The reservation itself rests on the 2016 Act, so the state step is implementation and monitoring; doubt remains.

cited.quote: continue to be exclusively extended to persons with more than 40% disability

rationale: C1 (2026 GO) describes the 2016 Act and says reservation and pension benefits are still limited to persons with more than 40% disability. No extract shows a state step to change the severity threshold from 60 to 40 percent; the other extracts are about taxes and reservations in promotion.

cited.quote: The Director of Pension is permitted to conduct the Pensioners’ Grievances Day Meeting once in a year in all Districts

rationale: C1 and C2 concern pensioners' grievance day meetings in districts, a different group and format, with no elected representatives or Assembly constituencies. C5 describes the CM Helpline and portal. No extract shows grievance hearings in all Assembly Constituencies with elected representatives.

None of C1-C5 concerns re-constituting a Legislative Council or any legal action towards it. They cover the Law policy note, higher education, an MLA nomination to a law university and an urban employment scheme.

cited.quote: sanction is accorded for Special desilting works in Bhavani, Amaravathi and Parambikulam Aliyar sub basins in Coimbatore Region

rationale: C2/C4 (GO 2022-06-01) sanction desilting works in Bhavani, Amaravathi and Parambikulam Aliyar sub basins, which is neighbouring work, not Noyyal restoration or a Bhavani-Noyyal-Amaravathi linkage. C1/C3 are audit report text on Amaravathi; C5 is only an index listing the Noyyal River System. No step for the commitment.

No extract is about the state repaying graduate education loans. C1 describes a minorities corporation's own education loans with repayment terms; C2 and C3 cover scholarships and assistance; C4 and C5 are teacher recruitment rules.

cited.quote: no person shall undertake any new project or new activity specified in the Second Schedule in the Protected Agricultural Zone

rationale: C1 mentions the Protected Agricultural Zone Act, 2020, which predates the government's taking office, and GO 17 only extends a committee studying hydrocarbons in areas other than the Delta. C2-C5 are about the City Gas Distribution policy. No new step to stop methane or shale gas projects in the Delta.

cited.quote: portal related to Internal Committees on 14.08.2024. This enables to monitor the formation and functioning of internal committees
Provide safe, secure and healthy working condition such that no women employee is disadvantaged

rationale: C4 reports a web portal on Internal Committees dated 14.08.2024 and a women-safety textile MoU, dedicated workplace women's safety measures. C2 (draft state rules, 2022-04-11) sets safety conditions for women employees but is only a preliminary notification. Directional commitment met by a dedicated measure; start of the C4 sentence is cut off.

cited.quote: the Government have decided to constitute a Special Task Force at District/City level

rationale: C1/C3 (GO 179, 2025-04-15) create district Special Task Forces on crime against women and children, a broader body not set up for workplace safety. C2 and C5 describe the 181 helpline, operational since 2018 and general. No task force or helpline specific to women's workplace safety is shown.

cited.quote: laptops are being distributed during the current year to 10 lakh students studying in various arts,

rationale: C1 shows laptops for college students; C2 shows tablets for teachers; C4 covers tablets for police stations. None provides tablets with 4G/5G connectivity and 10GB data to higher secondary or college students, so only related activity appears.

cited.quote: 3.5. Children born out of Inter Caste Marriage.- The children born out of inter- caste marriages

rationale: C2 (community certificate manual) only says how the community of children of inter-caste marriages is determined. C1, C3, C4 and C5 describe existing scholarship schemes for Adi Dravidar students with no extension to these children. No order extends scholarships to them.

cited.quote: The following members of the family of a deceased or medically invalidated Government servant

rationale: C1/C2 (GO 33, 2023-03-08) notify the Appointment on Compassionate Grounds Rules, 2023 for legal heirs of deceased government servants. No extract shows the Rs.5 lakh family welfare fund, and C3-C5 cover other schemes. Only the compassionate employment component is shown.

cited.quote: Deposit of Rs.5.00 lakh in the name of the child who had lost both the parents due to COVID-19

rationale: C2/C4 (GO 24) cover relief for children orphaned by Covid-19 with a district committee under the Collector. C1, C3 and C5 list existing women and child schemes. None is a special Women and Child Welfare Scheme under the Chief Minister's direct supervision.

cited.quote: Each beneficiary is provided with 8 gram (22 carat) gold coin along with cash assistance as follows
Scheme will continue to be implemented without any change

rationale: C1 (2025) still shows Rs.25,000 total for non-degree widow remarriage beneficiaries with the 8 gram gold coin. C4 (GO 46, 2022) says the Dharmambal scheme continues without any change. No order raises the amount to Rs.30,000.

cited.quote: Jallikattu events are to be conducted only in those places that are notified in the State Gazette

rationale: C1-C3 discuss Jallikattu regulation, safety and cultural status but mention no monthly Rs.1000 assistance to bull owners. C4 (HIV/AIDS children) and C5 (Tholkudi scheme) are about other schemes. No official step for the commitment.

cited.quote: A total of 15,890 sale deeds have been issued to the allottees from May 2021 to March 2024
During 2022-23, issue of sale deeds is being expedited by issue of draft sale deeds to allottees at their doorsteps

rationale: C1 reports 15,890 TNHB sale deeds issued May 2021-March 2024 through special camps; C3 shows Slum Clearance Board sale deeds being expedited in 2022-23 with an Empowered Committee, yet 83,921 plots and 1,00,528 tenements remain without deeds. Some issued, many pending; no GO date is given, so the year comes from C3.
